```{python}
#| include: false
import os
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.ticker import PercentFormatter

DIR_FILE = Path.cwd()
ROOT_DIR = os.path.dirname(DIR_FILE)
DATASET_PATH = os.path.join(
    ROOT_DIR, "dataset", "credit_card_fraud_detection_2026.csv")

df_all = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
df = df_all[df_all["merchant_country"] == country].copy()
assert len(df) > 0, f"Tidak ada data untuk {country}"

fraud_data = df.loc[df["is_fraud"] == 1]
n_total, n_fraud = len(df), int(df["is_fraud"].sum())
rate = n_fraud / n_total
baseline = df_all["is_fraud"].mean()   # baseline global (semua negara)
MIN_N = 30                             # segmen < 30 transaksi tidak ditampilkan

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
plt.rcParams["axes.spines.top"] = False
plt.rcParams["axes.spines.right"] = False

def bullets(*lines):
    print("\n".join(f"- {l}" for l in lines))

def wilson(k, n, z=1.96):
    p = k / n
    d = 1 + z**2 / n
    c = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / d
    h = z * np.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / d
    return c - h, c + h

def rate_table(data, col, min_n=MIN_N):
    g = (data.groupby(col, observed=True)
         .agg(n=("is_fraud", "size"), fraud=("is_fraud", "sum"))
         .reset_index())
    g = g[g["n"] >= min_n].copy()
    g["rate"] = g["fraud"] / g["n"]
    g["lift"] = g["rate"] / baseline
    g["lo"], g["hi"] = wilson(g["fraud"], g["n"])
    return g

def plot_rate(g, col, title, figsize=(7, 4), fs=9):
    g = g.sort_values("rate", ascending=False)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    sns.barplot(data=g, y=col, x="rate", order=g[col].tolist(),
                color="#4C72B0", ax=ax)
    ax.errorbar(g["rate"].values, np.arange(len(g)),
                xerr=[(g["rate"] - g["lo"]).values,
                      (g["hi"] - g["rate"]).values],
                fmt="none", ecolor="black", capsize=2, lw=1)
    ax.axvline(baseline, ls="--", color="#C44E52",
               label=f"Baseline global {baseline:.2%}")
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1, decimals=1))
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=fs)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Fraud Rate (95% CI)")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    ax.legend(frameon=False)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

def top_low(g, col, unit):
    s = g.sort_values("rate")
    top, low = s.iloc[-1], s.iloc[0]
    bullets(
        f"Tertinggi: **{top[col]}** {top['rate']:.2%} "
        f"({int(top['fraud'])} fraud dari {int(top['n']):,}).",
        f"Terendah: **{low[col]}** {low['rate']:.2%}.",
        f"{int((g['lo'] > baseline).sum())} dari {len(g)} {unit} punya "
        "batas bawah CI di atas baseline global.",
    )
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(f"# {country}\n")
print(f"## Ringkasan {country}\n")
bullets(
    f"**{n_total:,}** transaksi, **{n_fraud:,}** fraud (**{rate:.2%}**).",
    f"Baseline global **{baseline:.2%}**: {country} berada di "
    f"**{rate / baseline:.2f}x** baseline.",
    f"Dengan hanya {n_fraud:,} kasus fraud, segmen kecil berfluktuasi "
    "besar; baca bersama CI.",
)
```

## Distribution of Fraud
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
counts = df["is_fraud"].value_counts().reindex([0, 1], fill_value=0)
pct = counts / counts.sum() * 100

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
bars = ax.bar(["Non-Fraud", "Fraud"], counts.values,
              color=["#4C72B0", "#C44E52"])
for bar, n, p in zip(bars, counts.values, pct.values):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height(),
            f"{n:,}\n({p:.2f}%)", ha="center", va="bottom")
ax.set_title(f"Distribusi Fraud Negara {country}")
ax.set_ylabel("Jumlah transaksi")
ax.set_ylim(0, counts.max() * 1.15)
plt.show()
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
lo, hi = wilson(n_fraud, n_total)
bullets(
    "Data sangat imbalanced.",
    f"Fraud rate **{rate:.2%}** (CI 95%: {lo:.2%}-{hi:.2%}).",
    f"Baseline global {baseline:.2%}: "
    + ("CI mencakup baseline, selisih belum bermakna."
       if lo <= baseline <= hi else
       ("di atas baseline." if lo > baseline else "di bawah baseline.")),
)
```
:::
::: {.notes}
- Baseline global dipakai untuk menghitung lift tiap segmen

## Amount Distribution
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
loss = fraud_data["fraud_amount_lost"]
median_loss = loss.median()
p75_loss = loss.quantile(0.75)
hv, edges = np.histogram(loss, bins=40)
peak = (edges[hv.argmax()] + edges[hv.argmax() + 1]) / 2

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
sns.histplot(data=fraud_data, x="fraud_amount_lost", bins=40, kde=True,
             color="#E76F51", edgecolor="white", alpha=0.8, ax=ax)
ax.axvline(peak, color="#2A9D8F", ls="--", lw=2,
           label=f"Peak: ${peak:,.0f}")
ax.axvline(median_loss, color="#264653", ls="-.", lw=2,
           label=f"Median: ${median_loss:,.0f}")
ax.axvline(p75_loss, color="#FF392E", ls="--", lw=2,
           label=f"P75: ${p75_loss:,.0f}")
ax.set_title(f"Distribution of Fraud Amount Lost - {country}")
ax.set_xlabel("Fraud Amount Lost ($)")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Fraud Transactions")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
bullets(
    f"Total kerugian **\\${loss.sum():,.0f}**.",
    f"Puncak distribusi sekitar \\${peak:,.0f}, median \\${median_loss:,.0f}.",
    f"Kerugian terbesar \\${loss.max():,.0f}.",
    f"Median global \\${df_all.loc[df_all['is_fraud'] == 1, 'fraud_amount_lost'].median():,.0f}.",
)
```

## Transaction Amount: Fraud vs Non-Fraud

```{python}
plot_df = df.assign(kelas=df["is_fraud"].map({0: "Non-Fraud", 1: "Fraud"}))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
sns.boxplot(data=plot_df, x="kelas", y="transaction_amount",
            order=["Non-Fraud", "Fraud"], log_scale=True,

            ax=ax)
ax.set_title(f"Transaction Amount by Class (log) - {country}")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_ylabel("Amount ($, log)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Fraud Rate by Time of Day
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
blocks = pd.cut(df["transaction_hour"], bins=[-1, 5, 11, 17, 23],
                labels=["00-05", "06-11", "12-17", "18-23"])
g = rate_table(df.assign(blok=blocks), "blok")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.bar(g["blok"].astype(str), g["rate"], color="#4C72B0")
ax.errorbar(np.arange(len(g)), g["rate"],
            yerr=[(g["rate"] - g["lo"]).values,
                  (g["hi"] - g["rate"]).values],
            fmt="none", ecolor="black", capsize=3, lw=1)
ax.axhline(baseline, ls="--", color="#C44E52",
           label=f"Baseline global {baseline:.2%}")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1, decimals=1))
ax.set_title(f"Fraud Rate by Time Block - {country}")
ax.set_xlabel("Jam")
ax.set_ylabel("Fraud Rate (95% CI)")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
top_low(g, "blok", "blok waktu")
```
:::
::: {.notes}
- Jam dikelompokkan per 6 jam: per jam, fraud per segmen terlalu sedikit di negara kecil

## Fraud Type: Cases vs Loss
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
ft = (fraud_data.groupby("fraud_type")["fraud_amount_lost"]
      .agg(n="size", total="sum")
      .sort_values("total", ascending=False))
ft["share_n"] = ft["n"] / ft["n"].sum()
ft["share_loss"] = ft["total"] / ft["total"].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ft[["share_n", "share_loss"]].plot.barh(
    ax=ax, color=["#4C72B0", "#C44E52"])
ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1, decimals=0))
ax.set_title(f"Share of Cases vs Loss - {country}")
ax.set_xlabel("Share")
ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.legend(["Cases", "Loss"], frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
